subject: Clarify anchor discount evidence + reseller uplift for Thermion private offer
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@thermion.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@thermion.ai
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on the proposed private offer (anchor discount + reseller uplift)

Mateo — thanks for the proposal yesterday. A few quick clarifying questions from procurement so we can progress to internal approval: 

1) Anchor discount: your term sheet lists a 35% anchor against list price for the first 12 months conditional on a 36-month reserved commit. Can you confirm what evidence you need from us to lock that band (e.g., PO, signed SOW, revenue schedule)?

2) Reseller uplift: the draft notes a reseller uplift (10% margin) routed through ResellerCorp. Our reseller is new to marketplace flows — what documentation does Redwood require to treat the uplift as pass-through vs. incremental cost?

3) Invoicing / tax: we need to confirm invoice routing for EU-lawful billing and whether there will be any withholding language required.

If helpful, I can share a one-pager procurement checklist. We'd like to have answers before we route to legal next week.

Thanks —
Sarah Lim
Head of Procurement, Thermion AI
procurement@thermion.ai

--
Attachment: thermion-procurement-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@thermion.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on the proposed private offer (anchor discount + reseller uplift)

Hi Sarah — appreciate the fast turnaround. Answering inline: 

1) Anchor discount evidence: to lock the 35% anchor we need (a) signed PO referencing the private-offer id (we'll provide), (b) a schedule of committed spend by quarter, and (c) a short attestation from finance indicating the commit is funded/approved. The minimal set to apply the anchor immediately is PO + spend schedule; the attestation can follow within 10 business days.

2) Reseller uplift: for ResellerCorp to be treated as pass-through (i.e., uplift routed as reseller margin on your invoice), Redwood needs a reseller agreement or reseller certificate that shows ResellerCorp is an authorized reseller for Thermion (we accept a signed reseller addendum or a PDF certificate). If ResellerCorp will invoice you directly, we can support that too; in that case we need a billing routing confirmation and the reseller's tax ID.

3) Invoicing/tax: we'll produce an invoice to Thermion (US entity) by default. For EU billing, we'll need your EU-entity details and VAT #; our billing ops will add the EU invoice alias. Withholding language — please flag any specific clauses; our legal (cc: Kimberly) will confirm there are no standard blockers.

I've looped in Ben for channel / margin ops and Kimberly for contractual confirmation. Attaching the evidence checklist and a reseller template.

Next steps: if you can share the PO and reseller certificate, Ben will triage the uplift flow and we can freeze the anchor for signature.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-anchor-evidence-thermion.xlsx (pricing/evidence checklist), reseller_margin_cert_template.docx (template stub)

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Clarify anchor discount + reseller uplift — ops notes

Mateo / team — forwarding my internal ops notes after a quick review. High level:

- Anchor eligibility: PO + spend schedule will work. Flag: if Thermion asks for the anchor to apply retroactively to usage pre-PO, we should deny (we only backdate to signed effective date).
- Reseller uplift routing options: 
  * Option A (recommended): Reseller is listed as channel beneficiary on our invoice (Redwood invoices Thermion; we show reseller uplift line item). Requires reseller certificate + reseller tax ID.
  * Option B: Reseller invoices Thermion directly and Redwood invoices Thermion net of uplift. Requires reseller to register on marketplace / provide invoice copies for reconciliation. Slower ops path.
- Margin evidence: we can accept a signed reseller agreement OR a reseller certificate plus one invoice example showing the reseller's margin historically. If ResellerCorp is new we should request 2 references.

Kimberly — any legal redlines to those two options?

Ben
Director, Deal Operations | Redwood Inference

--

Thanks, Mateo and Ben — helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Thermion is comfortable with Option A. We'll ask ResellerCorp to provide the reseller certificate and tax ID by end of day Friday.
- Procurement asks that the PO include milestone-based drawdowns (quarterly commit release). Will Redwood accept a schedule that includes quarterly drawdown milestones tied to usage thresholds? If so, please confirm whether the anchor discount is maintained if thresholds are missed (we expect a pro-rata adjustment).

Dan — can you confirm you'll send the certificate + tax ID to Mateo?

Best,
Sarah

Thanks all — moving to action. Summary & next steps: 

1) Evidence received: Dan, we got the reseller_certificate + tax ID. Thanks — Ben will ingest the PDF and mark Option A in ops.
2) PO / drawdown schedule: Sarah, quarterly drawdowns tied to usage thresholds are acceptable. If a quarter misses the threshold, the anchor discount will be adjusted pro-rata for that quarter only (we will not retroactively remove prior periods that met thresholds). We will include precise language in the SOW: sample clause attached.
3) Ticketing and timelines: I'll open a single deal ticket (RDW-7342) in our ops queue that will track: evidence ingestion, billing alias setup (EU VAT), SOW draft, and DocuSign. Expect first ops update by EOD tomorrow.

Deliverables for Thermion to upload to the ticket: signed PO referencing DEAL-3421-TX, the quarterly spend schedule, and confirmation of the EU entity for invoicing (if applicable).

Kimberly / Irene — please confirm counterparty legal will accept the pro-rata adjustment language. If any contractual blockers, flag them in RDW-7342.

I'll circulate the DocuSign link once legal signs off. Thanks everyone — on track to convert to a private offer week of May 10.

Best regards,
Mateo Alvarez
